article image [...] (Kitco NewsWire) - Spot gold and silver prices are higher in late-afternoon U.S. trading Tuesday, as a softer-than-expected U.S. CPI report pushed Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar lower, helping metals recover even as crude oil stayed bid on renewed U.S.-Iran tension. title: Goldman Cuts Yen Forecast to 165 Per Dollar, Likes Carry Trades - Bloomberg
content:
The Wall Street bank has revised its forecast to 165 from 155, ranking it among the most bearish forecasters surveyed by Bloomberg. The change reflects fiscal pressures in Japan, higher-for-longer US Treasury yields and only gradual rate hikes from the Bank of Japan, strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman wrote in a note. ## Top trending stories [...] If Japan transforms from a reliable buyer into a persistent seller of Treasuries, bond markets could face a volatile adjustment. Higher Treasury yields would ripple throughout the American economy. Mortgage rates would remain elevated.

Corporate borrowing would become more expensive. Commercial real estate—already under pressure—could deteriorate further. [...] Whenever Japanese authorities intervene to support the yen, they must purchase yen using foreign currencies, primarily US dollars. Those dollars largely come from Japan’s enormous foreign reserves, much of which are invested in US Treasury bonds. Significant intervention, therefore, risks substantial Treasury sales.
